suite: V-REBUILD-01 — Derived projection delete/rebuild: vector index and FTS5 with interrupt/resume/discard semantics

sections.name: 1k vector projection: build → delete → rebuild → count/hash match
sections.description: Build a 1000-record vector projection, delete all rows from the partition, rebuild from the same record stream, assert count and membership hash are identical. Proves A8 rebuildability.
assertions: original build produces Activated outcome with count=1000
partition is empty after DELETE
rebuilt count equals original count
rebuilt membership hash equals original hash

sections.name: FTS delete → rebuild → count matches
sections.description: Index 200 FTS documents, delete all search_documents rows, rebuild from the same stream, assert count and membership hash are equal.
assertions: original FTS build produces Activated outcome with count=200
search_documents empty after DELETE
rebuilt FTS count equals original
rebuilt FTS membership hash equals original

sections.name: Interrupt vector rebuild midway → resume → final count/hash matches
sections.description: Inject a stream error after 500 of 1000 records; verify cursor is Interrupted; resume with the full record set; compare against a clean reference rebuild.
assertions: mid-stream error produces RebuildOutcome::Interrupted
cursor status is Interrupted after interrupt
resume (with full record set) produces Activated
resumed count equals reference count (1000)
resumed hash equals reference hash

sections.name: Interrupt rebuild midway → discard → fresh rebuild → matches
sections.description: Interrupt after 500 records, discard by deleting cursor and dropping the staging table, start a fresh rebuild with the full record set, compare against a clean reference.
assertions: mid-stream error produces RebuildOutcome::Interrupted
cursor absent after discard (DELETE)
staging table dropped after discard
post-discard fresh rebuild produces Activated
post-discard count equals reference count (1000)
post-discard hash equals reference hash

sections.name: Authority rows (events_v2, graph_revisions, authority_meta) unchanged by rebuild
sections.description: Commit two authority commands, snapshot events_v2 id-hash and revision state, then run full vector rebuild, interrupted vector rebuild, and FTS rebuild. Assert all three authority snapshots are identical before and after each operation.
assertions: events_v2 id-hash unchanged after full vector rebuild
authority_meta graph_revision unchanged after full vector rebuild
graph_revisions count unchanged after full vector rebuild
events_v2 id-hash unchanged after interrupted vector rebuild
authority_meta graph_revision unchanged after interrupted vector rebuild
graph_revisions count unchanged after interrupted vector rebuild
events_v2 id-hash unchanged after FTS rebuild
authority_meta graph_revision unchanged after FTS rebuild
graph_revisions count unchanged after FTS rebuild

notes: 100k scale: count-only assertion is deferred per task spec (too expensive inline); 1k and 10k-equivalent tests (1k vector + 200 FTS) cover the inline validation requirement.
vector rebuild uses 384-dim zero-filled vectors for deterministic membership hash.
FTS rebuild uses search_documents row count as membership metric (consistent with compute_fts_membership_hash).
Owner self-review acceptable per dev-context.md for this pre-production single-developer repository.
